title: Expose the real-time profile through the registry and SDK
requires: Any development host with registry generation and installed-SDK test tools
scope: Implement the separately versioned real-time profile contract from F8-00 in the registry, generated C API, loader/validation and reference-runtime selection. This task does not implement new solver equations or claim hardware qualification. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md.
acceptance: Reserve explicit profile/version and parameter semantics in registry/pm.xml before generated bindings; do not reinterpret existing timestep/substep fields or silently change legacy defaults. A documented incompatible version may replace the old solver; retaining two implementations is not required.
Test independently built old/new clients, negotiated new-profile selection, unsupported requests, invalid input envelopes and validation-on/off rejection behavior.
Runtime dispatch can select the new schedule only when implemented and supported; capability qualification remains separate from execution support and no unfinished solver is advertised as qualified.
Pass generated-contract, ABI, validation and installed-SDK gates; preserve historical evidence and either honor legacy requests or explicitly reject them under the reviewed version policy.
